name: Golgi vesicle traffic, lysosomal sorting and protein secretion
rationale: All members concern vesicle budding and transport through the Golgi; unlike confusables centred on COPI budding or endosome-to-Golgi retrieval, this theme adds TGN/lysosomal vesicle biogenesis, lysosomal targeting and secretion.

name: Cytoplasmic mRNA turnover via deadenylation and decapping
rationale: Members cover poly(A) shortening, cap removal, 5'-3' exonucleolytic decay and P-body assembly, distinguishing it from RBP/ARE-mediated stability, zygotic decay and polyadenylation confusables.

name: Extracellular matrix sequestration of signalling ligands
rationale: All members concern holding ligands such as BMP in the extracellular region away from receptors, unlike confusables that are intracellular BMP/TGF-beta, Wnt or patterning signalling.

name: HIF hypoxic response with glycolysis and oxygen transport
rationale: Members combine HIF stabilisation and hypoxic gene regulation with glycolytic glucose catabolism and erythroid oxygen transport, which the glycolysis-regulation and gluconeogenesis confusables lack.

qualifier: K6, K27, K29 and unanchored chains
name: Atypical lysine-linked and free polyubiquitin chain formation
rationale: All members are formation of non-canonical ubiquitin linkages or free chains, distinct from confusables about deubiquitination, mitophagy or K48/K63 regulation.

name: Neddylated cullin ligase protein turnover and PD-L1 stability
rationale: Members share cullin-RING ligase control by neddylation/COP9 deneddylation (including RHOBTB CUL3 adaptors), and uniquely include PD-L1 degradation and stabilisation affecting anti-tumour T cell responses.

name: Cardiac myocardium, septum and endocardium morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover trabecular/compact ventricular and atrial myocardium, septal and endocardial morphogenesis, unlike confusables focused on valves, coronary vessels or heart tube and second heart field.

name: Classical complement activation and its negative regulation
rationale: Members cover antibody-triggered classical complement activation and its inhibition, distinguishing it from alternative, lectin and C3/C5 activation confusables.

name: Mucopolysaccharidoses of chondroitin/dermatan, keratan and hyaluronan degradation
rationale: All members are GAG catabolism or its lysosomal storage defects; unlike the Sanfilippo-centred confusables, the theme spans CS/DS, keratan sulfate and hyaluronan as well as heparan sulfate.

name: Promotion of long-term synaptic plasticity and spine maturation
rationale: Members are positive regulators of LTP/LTD, structural plasticity, spine and synapse maturation, local translation and memory, unlike cAMP/CREB, NMDA receptor or reelin/dendrite maintenance confusables.

qualifier: pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide, de novo and salvage
name: Pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide biosynthesis by de novo and salvage
rationale: Members build pyrimidine ribonucleotides and deoxyribonucleotides via de novo and salvage routes, distinguishing them from nucleotide catabolism and purine biosynthesis confusables.

core: Extracellular protease cascades and their inhibition
qualifier: contact system, fibrinolysis and matrix degradation
name: Contact system, fibrinolysis and matrix proteolysis regulation
rationale: Members share plasma/extracellular proteolysis — FXII/kallikrein and bradykinin, plasminogen activation, MMP-driven collagen/elastin breakdown and serpin inhibition — unlike coagulation-cascade or ECM-adhesion confusables.

core: Branched-chain amino acid catabolism and its inborn errors
name: Branched-chain amino acid catabolism and biotin-dependent organic acidemias
rationale: Members are mitochondrial leucine/isoleucine/valine breakdown and its defects (MSUD, isovaleric acidemia, carboxylase and biotin disorders), distinct from PDH/OGDH, lipoylation and lysine catabolism confusables.

name: Two-pore and ATP-sensitive potassium channels in membrane potential
rationale: Members concern K+ channels and Na+/K+ pumps setting resting potential and ion homeostasis, unlike renal sodium transport, magnesium or smooth-muscle confusables.

name: Forebrain neuron migration and cortical layer development
rationale: Members cover radial and tangential neuron (interneuron) migration and cortical, hippocampal and thalamic development, unlike spinal cord patterning, commissure or forebrain patterning confusables.

name: Solute carrier transport of dicarboxylates and cationic amino acids
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated movement of succinate/citrate, malate-aspartate shuttle and lysine/arginine/ornithine with their transporter disorders, unlike glutamate/urea-cycle metabolism or carnitine confusables.

name: Craniofacial, palate and limb morphogenesis
rationale: Members share mesenchyme-driven morphogenesis of face, palate, skull and limbs/digits, unlike ear, pharyngeal-organ or neural plate confusables.

name: Treg differentiation and restraint of effector T cells
rationale: Members promote regulatory T cell differentiation and dampen Th17 commitment, IFN-gamma and CD4/CD8 T cell activation, unlike tolerance/anergy, Th1 or dendritic cell confusables.

name: eNOS activation and nitric oxide-cGMP vasorelaxation
rationale: Members cover eNOS regulation/trafficking, NO-cGMP signalling and vascular smooth muscle relaxation, unlike natriuretic/renal, vasoconstriction or shear-stress confusables.

qualifier: NGF-induced CREB via p38 and ERK5
name: NGF-induced transcription via p38, ERK5 and CREB
rationale: All four members are downstream NGF signalling to p38/ERK5 and CREB-driven transcription, unlike receptor-proximal NTRK3, TRKA activation or BDNF confusables.

name: HIF-mediated oxygen sensing and hypoxic gene regulation
rationale: Members centre on oxygen-dependent HIF-alpha hydroxylation and HIF target expression, distinguishing it from glycolytic enzyme, mTORC1/p53 metabolic and NRF2 confusables.

core: Renal regulation of blood pressure and volume
name: Aldosterone-responsive renal sodium handling and blood pressure
rationale: Members concern aldosterone response, sodium import, glomerular filtration and renal blood-pressure control, unlike vasopressin water, angiotensin metabolism or aldosterone synthesis confusables.

name: Ca2+-activated phospholipid scrambling, translocation and membrane blebbing
rationale: Members cover ANO6-type scrambling, aminophospholipid flipping, blebbing and cell shrinkage, unlike intermembrane lipid transfer or apoptotic-cell clearance confusables.

name: MHC class I antigen processing, loading and cross-presentation
rationale: Members cover proteasomal processing, peptide loading of class I and cross-presentation of exogenous antigen, unlike class II, proteasome assembly or Nef downregulation confusables.

name: Circulating monocyte surface receptors and CD1 antigen presentation
rationale: Members are monocyte/DC surface and receptor gene signatures plus CD1 lipid presentation and monocyte differentiation, unlike activated myeloid, neutrophil or DC-only confusables.
